title: MLClaim input v1
description: Domain claim payload assessed by the ML adapter's validate_claim. claim_class is the gate declaration: the evidentiary tier the claim asserts (engineering correctness, data acceptance, or out-of-sample generalization). The adapter maps claim_class plus evidence provenance, seed multiplicity, and frozen-holdout discipline to a maturity ceiling and never grants externally_validated or production_observed (ADR-0008 decision 4; ADR-0005 decisions 4/7). case_sha256 pins the exact ml-case payload this claim answers and declared_assessment_gaps is the machine-checked gap acknowledgment (ADR-0008 addendum A3). OOD/subgroup/calibration/drift gaps are named in the assessment without moving the ceiling; their limitation sentences live in this payload's limitations field.

study_id.description: Study this claim belongs to; binds the claim to the task/case scope of one study.

case_sha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 of the ml-case payload this claim answers; the adapter fails closed when it differs from the contract's case_sha256 (ADR-0008 addendum A3).

claim_class.description: Evidentiary tier asserted: engineering (pipeline/run correctness), data_acceptance (dataset audit passed), generalization (out-of-sample generalization result on the empirical_claim path; this adapter never produces predictive_claim — ADR-0008 addendum A2).

outcome.description: Outcome asserted by the source system. An asserted pass on a generalization claim does not by itself raise the evidence ceiling; provenance, seed multiplicity, and frozen-holdout discipline do.

limitations.description: Known limitations of the claim, including the machine-assisted limitation sentences (missing OOD/subgroup evaluation, unevaluated calibration/drift, small-sample or single-seed caveats; ADR-0008 decision 4). Required; explicit empty array only after consideration.

declared_assessment_gaps.description: Assessment gaps this claim explicitly acknowledges, by dimension (ADR-0008 addendum A3): the machine-checked counterpart of the prose limitations. validate_claim fails closed when the gaps it detects from the case's assessment declaration and the supplied evidence are not a subset of this set; an explicit empty array declares no gaps.

non_entailments.description: Statements this claim explicitly does not establish (for example: a synthetic-data result does not entail real-data validity; a single-seed best value is not a stable claim; validation-selected metrics do not entail test performance).
